result.text:
The internet is a pretty magical place.

One day, you're collaborating with someone through issues, PRs and GitHub discussions. 

The next, you're standing next to them at @github  Universe, talking about everything except code.

A few days of good conversations, familiar faces, new friendships and endless inspiration. Open source is really just people finding each other through things they love building.

And I think that's beautiful 🖤
